name: Caroline Chisholm Education Foundation General Scholarship
summary: Fee help for Chisholm VET students with a Health Care Card: up to $1,000 for Free TAFE courses or $800 for other courses.
key: In 2026, the limit is $1,000 for Free TAFE courses and $800 for non-Free TAFE courses; foundation courses and VCE are fully funded.
who: Current Centrelink Health Care Card holder
Government-subsidised place (Certificate IV and below) or VET Student Loan (Diploma and above)
how: Download the General Scholarship form and email it to ccefscholarships@chisholm.edu.au
catches: Does not cover apprenticeships, traineeships or short courses
Only one course at a time under a CCEF scholarship

evidence.quote: Scholarship applications are open throughout the year.
